delete.label: Delete user
delete.error: The user could not be deleted.
delete.confirm: Do you really want to delete the user ?

update.label: Edit user
update.error: The changes could not be saved

delete.label: Delete Firebase user
delete.error: The Firebase user could not be deleted.
delete.confirm: Do you really want to delete the Firebase user ?

change.label: Change username
change.signout: {name} logs in with a username. After the change, {name} is signed out once and then logs in again with the new username.
change.invalid: A username has 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
change.error: The username could not be changed.

open.label: Open account
open.createdWithLoginId: The account is open. The email already belongs to someone else, so {name} logs in with the username {loginId}.
open.exists: This person already has an account.
open.noEmail: There is no email for this person. An account cannot be opened without one.
open.error: The account could not be opened.

reset.label: Send password link
reset.conf: The link to set a password has been requested.
reset.error: The link to set a password could not be requested.

swap.label: Swap email
swap.confirm: {holder} hands the email over to {newcomer} and will log in with the username {loginId} from now on. {holder} is signed out once.
swap.minor: {holder} is under 18 — swapping is usually right here.
swap.noHolder: Nobody else here logs in with this email. There is nothing to swap.
swap.noLoginId: {holder} does not have a username yet. Please try again tomorrow.
swap.conf: Swapped. {holder} now logs in with the username {loginId} — please pass it on. {newcomer} gets a link to set a password.
swap.error: The email could not be swapped.

hasAccount.title: Mirror app access onto the persons
hasAccount.label: Records for every person which tenants they hold an account in. Needed so you can only invite people who are able to sign in here.
hasAccount.confirm: The field is recomputed for all persons, across all tenants. No existing data is lost. Continue?

invoices.title: Accounts receivable invoices (Invoices)
invoices.subtitle: This function is intended for the initial download of accounts receivable invoices from Bexio. Once this initial sync has been done, future invoices are added daily in the early morning.
invoices.nodata: No invoices found. Load the data from Bexio first.

bills.title: Accounts payable invoices (Bills)
bills.subtitle: This function is intended for the initial download of accounts payable invoices from Bexio. Once this initial sync has been done, future invoices are added daily in the early morning.
bills.nodata: No invoices found. Load the data from Bexio first.

journal.title: Journal (Entries)
journal.subtitle: Initial download of all accounting journal entries from Bexio. New entries are then synced daily at 06:15.
journal.nodata: No entries found. Load the data from Bexio first.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Download account groups and accounts from Bexio as a hierarchical AccountModel structure into the Firestore accounts collection.
accounts.nodata: No entries found. Load the data from Bexio first.
accounts.download: Download account groups and accounts from Bexio and save them as a chart of accounts in a tree structure.

index.title: Sync Bexio contacts
index.content: All persons, organizations and their memberships with the default organization are loaded. The BexioID in these entities is reconciled. Then all contacts are loaded from Bexio and inserted into the same list and checked. For missing entries, an add button appears for reconciliation.

error.credentials: Bexio rejected the API token. The API token (secret BEXIO_APIKEY) has to be renewed. Until then the Bexio columns stay empty.
error.fetch: The Bexio contacts could not be loaded. The Bexio columns stay empty.

vendor.title: Vendors (Vendor)
vendor.subtitle: Links the vendors of the bills with persons or orgs based on the name.

chat.title: Chat Admin (Matrix)
chat.name: Name
chat.note: If no person is selected, all chat rooms are shown. If a person is selected, all chat rooms where this person is a member are shown.
chat.choose_room_or_member:
Select room or member
to show details

roomMember.label: Select person
roomMember.description: If the field is empty, all chat rooms are shown. By selecting a person you limit the selection to all rooms where this person is a member.

delete.label: Delete room
delete.confirm: Really delete room {{ roomId }} ? All messages will be removed.

history.label: Read history
history.empty: Nothing has been written in this room yet.
history.hint: Read-only. You do not join the room, and nobody sees that you are reading along.

convert.label: Convert into a group
convert.message: This chat becomes a real group with a member list. Everyone currently in it stays, and no message is lost. The chat stays closed — only members can enter, and anyone joining later reads along from that point on. What else should the group get?
convert.conf: The chat is now a group

deactivate.label: Deactivate Matrix user
deactivate.confirm: Deactivate {{ userId }}? The user will no longer be able to sign in.

log.title: Matrix SDK log level
log.description: Controls how verbosely the Matrix SDK (matrix-js-sdk) writes to the browser console – for chat troubleshooting only. The selection is retained across reloads. Default: warn. Set to trace/debug for verbose logs, to silent for none.

names.label: Repair display names
names.description: Sets missing Matrix display names from the person name (first name last name). Accounts with their own name remain untouched.
names.none: All display names are correct – nothing to repair.
names.skipped_custom: Accounts with their own display name skipped.
names.confirm: Set {{ count }} display names from the person names now?

avatars.label: Repair avatars
avatars.description: Sets missing Matrix avatars from the person avatar. Accounts with their own avatar remain untouched.
avatars.none: All accounts have an avatar – nothing to repair.
avatars.skipped_has: Accounts with their own avatar skipped.
avatars.confirm: Set {{ count }} avatars from the person avatars now?

tenants.label: Assign chat rooms to tenants
tenants.description: One Matrix account serves every tenant. This repair marks existing group rooms with their group's tenants, so the chat only lists this tenant's rooms. Direct messages are deliberately left unmarked (they are placed by their counterpart); rooms without an unambiguous assignment stay unmarked and remain visible everywhere.
tenants.none: All rooms are already assigned — nothing to do.
tenants.ambiguous: rooms without an unambiguous assignment skipped (they stay visible everywhere).
tenants.confirm: Assign {{ count }} chat rooms to their tenants now?

guests.label: Non-members in group chats
guests.description: Shows, per group, how many people sit in the chat room without being on the member list, and flags the affected rooms in the list. Nothing is changed here.
guests.none: Every group chat holds members only — nothing to do.
guests.link_text: Syncing members, setting write permissions and removing non-members are in the menu of the group list.

assign.label: Assign rooms by hand
assign.description: Some chat rooms belong to no group — for example rooms created by a connection to Signal or WhatsApp. The automatic assignment cannot recognise them, so you decide here: rooms you assign to this app appear in the chat overview; hidden rooms appear in no app. Either way they stay readable in Element.
assign.none: Every room is assigned – nothing to do.
assign.confirm_here: Assign the room “{{ name }}” to this app? It will then appear in the chat overview.
assign.confirm_hide: Hide the room “{{ name }}”? It will then appear in no app.

blocked.title: Chat temporarily unavailable
blocked.default: The chat is currently under maintenance. It will be back soon.
blocked.call: Calls are not possible during maintenance.

block.title: Block chat
block.description: Blocks the chat in all apps. Everyone sees your message instead of the chat.
block.confirm: The chat will be blocked in all apps. Do you want to continue?
block.exemptHint: These people can still use and test the chat while it is blocked.

unblock.confirm: The chat will be available again in all apps. Do you want to continue?

validate.title: Data validation
validate.content: Bulk operation (adminops/validateModels) with validation operations on a collection.

index.title: Create index
index.content: Creates an index on a collection. This is useful when an index is missing in the database and a query cannot be executed.

personSelect.title: Select person
personSelect.content: Most of the operations below are based on a person. Therefore, a person must be selected here first. The operations can then be performed on this person.

account.title: Create user account
account.content: An existing person is registered as a user in Firebase Auth, i.e. the Firebase account and the user are created. If the Firebase account already exists, only a user is created that links the Firebase account and the person.

assignment.title: Assign roles
assignment.content: Assign and check assignments of roles to persons.

check.title: Check user account
check.content: Check whether a person has a user account in Firebase Auth or whether the prerequisites for creating the account are met.

fbuser.title: Edit Firebase user
fbuser.content: Edit an existing Firebase user. The change is made only in Firebase Auth; if necessary, the UserModel or PersonModel must also be changed.

impersonate.title: Impersonate user
impersonate.content: The user's role is temporarily set to the selected user. This allows the admin to use the application as this user. To return to the admin role, the admin must sign out and sign in again.

password.label: Password
password.error: The password must be at least 6 characters long.
password.helper: Here you can set a password for the selected user (e.g. for testing purposes). An empty password field results in a random password. The user can then set their own password with a password reset.
password.set: Set a new password for the selected user without triggering a password reset email. An empty password field results in a random password.
password.reset: Send a password reset email to the selected user.

privileged.title: Users with extended roles
privileged.content: All users who have more than the role 'registered'.

session.title: Sessions
session.empty: No sessions in the selected period

orgSelect.content: Choose the organisation whose tenants you want to change.

resourceSelect.content: Choose the resource whose tenants you want to change.

topup.title: Share missing data
topup.nothing: There is nothing left to share with this club — it already has everything you can pass on.

block.alwaysHint: The person's name, attributes and search terms live in a single record, so they always travel along.

allocation.legalNote: You are sharing personal data with another club. Make sure you are allowed to.
allocation.ownTenantHint: You cannot remove your own tenant here.

account.title: Access
account.hint: This lets the person sign in to the other club. They set their own password via “Forgot password”.
account.emailChoice: Which address should they sign in with?
account.createdWithLoginId: The access has been opened with the username {loginId}. The email already belongs to another access. If both accesses are managed here, you can swap the email under user accounts.
account.failed: The access could not be opened.

email.taken: This email already has an access. If it belongs to another person, the new access is opened with a username.
